Key responsibilities include Understand power control systems and topologies relevant to modern datacenter architectures to ensure accurate verification of related requirements; Identify opportunities for test automation in embedded software environments and implement robust tools and libraries as part of a test framework; Define test specifications based on requirements and develop automated test code to maintain stable regression suites with full traceability; Analyze results to identify defects, collaborate with developers during debugging, and ensure root cause analysis is documented; Check quality of software releases and verify/sign-off against acceptance criteria; Prepare test reports, summarizing test results, findings, and recommendations; Provide feedback to developers on identified issues and areas for improvement; Apply software industry best practices, including CI/CD workflows, version control, static analysis, and automated testing frameworks; Ensure the quality and reliability of software releases through rigorous verification processes, actively developing and maintaining CI/CD workflows for embedded systems. Minimum Qualifications/skills Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Science; 5+ years of industry experience in embedded systems or software testing; Minimum 3 years hands on experience in developing test code for software systems using Python and PyTest; Hands on experience with CI/CD tool environments such as Jenkins/Github Actions; Excellent written and verbal communication skills; Basic knowledge of protocols used in embedded systems (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN); Working Knowledge of Signal Processing concepts such as Filters, Fast Fourier Transforms, Harmonic Distortion, etc. Preferred Qualifications Knowledge of power systems, DC/DC conversion; Knowledge about containerization with docker; ISTQ certification; Experience in software development with C/C++ and testing such as Ceedling, Unity, GoogleTests; Experience with code coverage such as Gcov; Experience with Agile workflows such as Scrum or Kanban.
